_README: Curated Music/SFX library operations catalog (docs/plans/vizard-parity.md "Music/SFX library"). Content must be sourced ONLY from the YouTube Audio Library's no-attribution tracks and Pixabay — never NCS-style packs (documented Content-ID false-positive risk even when a pack is labeled royalty-free). User-facing copy describing this library must say 'royalty-free', never 'monetization-safe' or 'no Content ID claims' — even providers with strong licensing terms cannot guarantee that. Populating this catalog and the corresponding database/R2 records with real tracks/SFX (target: ~120-200 music tracks across 6-10 mood tags, 30-60 SFX) is a content/ops task, not a code task — the entries below are placeholders only, and their storageKey values do not point at real R2 objects.
